#| results: "asis"

source("../_common.R")

## Built-in palettes

SCpubr includes several built-in color palettes optimized for single-cell visualization.

## Colorblind-safe palettes

When you set `colorblind = TRUE`, SCpubr automatically selects from a collection of colorblind-safe palettes based on the number of categories in your data.

## Creating custom palettes

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Generate a palette
colors <- SCpubr::do_ColorPalette(n = 10)

# Test for colorblind accessibility
SCpubr::do_ColorBlindCheck(colors = colors)
```
